name: CAUTION_ICE_SLIPPERY_GREEN_TALL

w5-20_slippery_car.desc: AS 1743 W5-20 skidding car (national symbol reused; the sheet says 'for details of slippery sign refer AS 1742 W5-20B')

notes: Department of State Growth (formerly DIER) standard drawing, black line-work sheet; every dimension from the sheet unless stated. Series/heights as the sheet's letter-type note; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing, so widths differ from the sheet's figures where its spacing is wider (the TAS sheets' 'medium'/'75%' spacing runs about 7% wider than AS 1744 normal spacing). Sheet 3403-3/P92 'Slippery - ice warning sign type 1' (2002), hinged fold-out sign 1200 x 2150, 50 rad. Top panel 1100: a W5-20 slippery diamond (black on Class 1 yellow, yellow edge 10 / black border 20 / R50 as AS 1743 W5-20) on a standard green background; the diamond is not dimensioned: measured on the sheet 1010 across the diagonals (side 715; a W5-20 B size would be 750 / 1061), centred in the top panel (top 50). Lower panel 1050, Class 1 yellow with 20 black border and 10 outer yellow edge; CAUTION 200 Series C '75% spacing' top 1270 (170 below the panel joint), ICE 340 Series E top 1620 (rows 170/200/150/340/190). The sheet's width figures are swapped between the lines (220/780/200 against CAUTION, 110/962/128 against ICE): the drawn CAUTION measures 958 and ICE 780, so expect CAUTION 962 / ICE 780 (AS 1744: 900 / 748). Legend centred (the sheet's margins are 1 cm off-centre).
